title: Read review
text: Read review. I bought this for my uncle who loves my one cup coffee maker. I was so embarrassed when he opened it up. The enclosed coffee cup is VERY small. The opening is too small to fit a bigger cup in it. It is more like a tiny expressi cup. I guess it would be ok if you didn't want over around 6 ounces of cofee
